text.en: Falling blood oxygen is the primary, moment-to-moment trigger for breathing -- in reality, central chemoreceptors in the brainstem, responding primarily to rising carbon dioxide, provide the dominant drive to breathe under normal conditions; peripheral chemoreceptors responding to oxygen only become the dominant drive once oxygen falls to a fairly low level, so oxygen is actually a backup trigger, not the primary one.
text.et: Langev vere hapnikusisaldus on hingamise peamine, hetkeline stiimul -- tegelikult annavad ajutüve kesksed kemoretseptorid, mis reageerivad peamiselt tõusvale süsihappegaasile, normaalsetes tingimustes domineeriva hingamistungi; hapnikule reageerivad perifeersed kemoretseptorid saavad domineerivaks tungiks alles siis, kui hapnik langeb üsna madalale tasemele, mistõttu hapnik on tegelikult varutrigger, mitte peamine.
